item.title: The Pelicans Broke How I Understand Pro Basketball | Defector
item.description:
It's unlikely that you spend much time thinking about the New Orleans Pelicans. However, as a New Orleans resident for whom ball is life, I am rather fixated on them. This team is far stranger than you may have previously understood.

item.title: Nobody got laid at BYU last night, but it looked like a fun party all…
item.description: Nobody got laid at BYU last night, but it looked like a fun party all the same. The eighth-ranked Cougars hosted the No. 2 Notre Dame Fighting Irish in the big primetime slot Saturday, and they stayed undefeated by squeaking out a 28-24 win.

item.title: How to Work Hard
item.description:
